subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should core doctor leave schemaless external channel config untouched for this groupAllowFrom migration, or should external plugins get an explicit opt-in migration contract first?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but changing a released migration from permissive to fail-closed is an external plugin compatibility boundary choice.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write keys into external plugin config without a visible schema.

options.title: Add External Opt-In Contract
options.body: Pause and design a plugin doctor or schema capability so non-bundled channels can opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Proven Protection
options.body: Use broader config-protection work only if it proves the same external email/RCS regression and keeps focused coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Core Writes
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write keys into external plugin config without a visible schema.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, making it the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
